package.name: autokart_dashboard_gateway
package.description: Read-only ROS-to-WebSocket/HTTP Mission Control gateway. Reuses the real, already-tested autokart_dashboard_gateway implementation via a lazy, path-parameterized import. Standalone, portable node from the autokart_ros_nodes library. The only effect a browser can have on the vehicle is a bounded, whitelisted request string evaluated by autokart_safety (node 10) -- this node has no actuator publisher and cannot bypass that gate.
